author: BB5
quote:
Does not live up to the legacy of GTA V at all. At all. And this was always going to be compared to GTA V as the baseline we grew up playing and what built the franchise's brand reputation.

Compared to the amount of heists / actual "grand theft auto" missions throughout GTA V which kept the stakes high and tension throughout from the get go (literally from the first mission "Prologue"), I found the missions in GTA VI to be incredibly boring and slow. Honestly they are full of silly household tasks / other meaningless side quests and overall felt more like "The Sims" or a quasi relationship simulator than than a GTA title... Seriously all this relationship stuff like WTF is this? Like sometimes I am sat there, stop playing for a moment and just thinking is this actually a GTA entry??

Probably my biggest issue is that I found the characters to be incredibly lacking in personality and hard to relate to - they just don't have anywhere near the chemistry of Franklin / Michael / Trevor etc. that made GTA V so enjoyable for me. This applies to secondary characters too, probably even more so than the main leads Jason / Lucia. This just makes it so hard to feel immersed in the game and drawn back to play again and again.

30 FPS is another problem. I'm not super bothered about these things normally. But several instances particularly in shootouts were even I could notice problems on my screen. 13 years and this is the best they can do? Honestly disappointing.

There are some positives sure, I'm not unbiased and can accept that several things in the actual game design are better / an improvement vs. the previous GTA entry. But honestly, given the 13 year wait (they have had sooo long to work on this and technology naturally is expected to advance over time), plus the magnitude of the above which are all critical points to me, this still gets a 0. Not even mad, just disappointed and upset that something so many people were waiting so long for does not live up to expectations.
